title: Conversion map
description: Every Common.Drift recipe-file construct and what it becomes (conversion.md). Construct keys are what the suite's conversion test derives from a recipe file: file.<key>, files.<string|list>, recipe.<property>[.<form>], case.<property>[.<value>], step.<name>, filter.<name>, regex.<feature>, own.<property>, own.step.<name>, own.name.group2plus, exception.<form>, kind.<kind>.

to.description: Where it goes, when not the same place

change.description: The semantic change in conversion.md it falls under, if any
